blockers: materialize and hash-bind the metadata-only development and sealed-audit selection
bind the accepted corrected structural base and complete Estonia condition snapshot
freeze the C1 algorithm, coefficients, code revision, uv lock, and thresholds
freeze the preview extent, cameras, cost expectation, and visual rule

forbidden_claims: measured morphology fit or real-vs-real non-inferiority

included: open intact raised-bog peat with a completely parsed peat profile and resolved humus-horizon semantics
ground-attached moss hummock lawn and hollow relief
single-valued stable peat surface outside water and dynamic vegetation

soil_semantics.pure_raised_bog_blank_humus: distinct_humus_horizon_not_applicable only when every bound soil component is raised-bog and its complete Loimis profile parses as peat; official retained soil documentation defines deep bog profiles as T-only and peat thickness/decomposition in the texture formula

required_condition_fields: connected ETAK mire unit and coverage confidence
full soil mixture layers peat thickness and humus
corrected structural height slope and curvature
forest open-water ditch cut-peat road building object dynamic and ownership-unknown masks
dated RGB and CIR exclusion/state evidence without height copying
excluded: drained cut restored or actively extracted peat
palsa thermokarst floating mat or pool surface
open water ditch building road object dynamic vegetation and non-heightfield geometry
unknown peat profile intactness land cover or ownership

site_selection.source_rule: Use national structured ETAK soil geology and land-cover metadata only; do not read DTM RGB CIR or detailed geometry pixels before identities are frozen.
site_selection.candidate_unit: one connected named mire complex after metadata exclusions

development.eligibility: all included-scope predicates resolved true with a contiguous 128 m development core plus the complete declared halo

sealed_abstention_audit.eligibility: a different connected mire complex with raised-bog metadata but at least one required intactness soil forest drainage or ownership condition unresolved and no known hard-excluded object
sealed_abstention_audit.separation: no physical-context or fine-halo overlap with the development mire
sealed_abstention_audit.allowed_pass: C1 is identically absent on unresolved or out-of-envelope ownership

global_exclusions: any site previously used for candidate tuning or threshold selection
any Taevaskoda review or sentinel extent

required_structure: hummock lawn and hollow form identities remain typed and inspectable
form marks are sampled from a multi-group descriptive distribution rather than one repeated primitive
form interaction and orientation are conditioned by whole-mire hydrology and local supported conditions
any within-form fine remainder is subordinate to recognizable forms and separately typed

descriptor_capacity_gate.method: Boundary-erode each retained Moore plot, apply the pinned HuHoLa-supported 0.5 m classification only within valid support, and summarize whole typed forms by geographic group without pixelwise training.

whole_domain_and_seam_law.physical_context: Compute drainage wetness and condition context over the entire connected selected mire and its required upstream or boundary context.
whole_domain_and_seam_law.maximum_preview_core: one complete 512 m LOD -1 parent and its 16 LOD -2 children
fine_halo_must_cover: maximum C1 form interaction and support radius
whole_domain_and_seam_law.global_identity: Use Section 13.3 world-coordinate PRF with no chunk IDs seeds or worker-order state.
whole_domain_and_seam_law.composition: Generate one canonical absolute fine canvas over core plus halo, apply confidence transitions only at real physical support boundaries, then crop storage chunks.
forbidden: wrap clamp or reflection at storage boundaries
hard relief edge at ETAK soil geology or ownership polygons
whole_domain_and_seam_law.shared_crop_requirement: Repeated overlapping crops from the same frozen domain must be bit-identical before quantization.

seeds.selection_rule: Only the canonical seed may become the preview candidate; sensitivity seeds may reject it but may not replace it.

required_metrics: typed form count class fraction relief footprint axes asymmetry spacing adjacency and connectivity by Moore group
C0 versus C1 height gradient normal curvature extrema and HuHoLa class descriptors
normative F4 R4 B1 and B2 descriptive energy without target wording
whole-domain versus crop partition and worker-order identity
shared-edge and decoded quantized normal continuity
one-meter phase energy and chunk-grid leakage
periodicity repeated-form nearest-source and effective-shape-use diagnostics
packed survival compressed bytes peak RSS scratch and wall time
hard_rejections: descriptor capacity below the frozen gate
residual in water hard-excluded or ownership-unknown cells
nonzero C1 on the sealed abstention audit
chunk seed edge apron partition or worker-order dependence
one repeated primitive copied source relief periodic lattice FBM or generic noise
hummock lawn and hollow forms not recognizable as typed connected morphology
hard ETAK soil geology condition or coverage seam
packing hierarchy quantization inherited-layer or runtime-consumer failure
missing metric threshold artifact or budget overrun

index_must_bind: source condition recipe code environment and seed hashes
